purpose: The prompt-building, reply-parsing and storage paths behind the audio briefing, the orchestrator pipeline, context suggestions and the summarizer and evaluator run in every gate run against replies the production model really gave, with no provider call and no credential, and a prompt change that outdates a recording fails loudly instead of replaying a stale answer.
form:
Record once against the real model, replay from the stub that already stands in for the LLM.

1. `daemon/tests/conftest.py`: `local_pipeline_stub` (line 289) gains a recording mode on its `/v1/chat/completions` handler. The fixture learns the running test's node id; each call within that test takes the next index. Recordings live at `daemon/tests/fixtures/llm_recordings/<test module>/<test name>.json` as an ordered list of `{request, reply, model}`.
   - Replay (the default, every gate and CI run): the handler serves the recorded reply for this test and index after checking that the live request, with ISO dates, 'Month D, YYYY' dates and the model name replaced by fixed tokens, equals the recorded request normalized the same way. A missing recording or a mismatch fails the test with a message naming the recording file and the record command; it never falls back to the canned reply or to the network.
   - Record (only when `PRISMIS_RECORD_LLM=<service>` is set, operator-run): the handler forwards the request unchanged except for the model, which is `PRISMIS_RECORD_MODEL` or the service's default, to that service as defined in the operator's real llm-core services.toml (read before the suite seals XDG), and writes the request, the real reply and the model to the recording file.
   - Tests that do not opt into recordings keep today's canned reply.

2. The gated tests drop their skip marks and run through the stub: test_audio_api_integration.py `test_audio_generates_with_high_priority`, test_daemon_integration.py `test_daemon_orchestration_with_test_database` (its source becomes the stub's `/feed.xml` instead of simonwillison.net), the two in test_context_api.py, and the four in test_summarizer_evaluator_integration.py, each configured with `configure_local_services` and keeping its existing assertions, which now check prismis's handling of a real reply. The audio test keeps its stand-in lspeak.

3. The recordings are made once with `PRISMIS_RECORD_LLM=openrouter PRISMIS_RECORD_MODEL=openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, the production light and deep model on cerebro, about a dozen calls, and committed.

4. test_llm_client_live_integration.py is unchanged: live, opt-in under PRISMIS_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1.

5. Tests of the mechanism: replay with the recording present passes under the `no_network` fixture (proving no provider call); a recording whose request differs in prompt text fails with the re-record message; a missing recording fails, not skips; a date-only difference replays. `docs/architecture/boundaries.md` notes, in the test section the gate contract sits beside, that LLM-backed integration tests replay recorded real replies and how to re-record.
commitments: Every test that today skips for want of a live LLM, except the provider-behavior tests, runs in the gate.
Replays use replies the production model actually returned, recorded once and committed.
A replay makes no network call; a missing or outdated recording fails the test with the command to re-record, never skips or falls back.
Dates and the model name are the only request text a replay ignores.
No new dependency; the existing local stub does the recording and replaying.
Provider-behavior tests stay live and opt-in.
sacrifices: A prompt edit to one of these paths requires re-recording its tests, about a dozen light calls, before the gate passes.
Replays prove prismis handles one real reply per call, not that the model will keep answering the same way.
Recording needs a machine with real llm-core credentials; CI only replays.
risk: If the normalizer misses another volatile part of a request, those tests fail on replay with the re-record message, which is loud; if a recorded reply is unusual, the test checks prismis against that one reply until it is re-recorded.
